slots.sentence: These include a ban on evictions of vulnerable tenants until 2030, a two-year rent freeze extension for existing leases, and tighter rules for short-term rentals.

slots.name: government seats
slots.sentence: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's minority leftist government has only 147 seats in the 350-seat chamber and relies on the support of a patchwork of smaller parties to pass legislation.

slots.name: Junts MPs
slots.sentence: Junts, a separatist centre-right party with seven MPs, argued that the proposed measures would make matters worse by reducing housing supply.

slots.name: second decree status
slots.sentence: A second decree, which would permit automatic and indefinite renewal of rental contracts, was already expected not to pass, failing to secure the minimum support required from Spain's fractured Congress.
